a radio communications failure between marine one and dca air traffic controllers occurred on august 4, 2026, when the presidential helicopter came into close proximity with an envoy air embraer e170.
the faa estimated the two aircraft came within about 0.82 nautical miles laterally and 700 feet vertically of each other about two miles north of dca.

the incident occurred as marine one, a sikorsky vh-3d carrying us president donald trump, departed the ellipse at about 14:34 local time while envoy air flight 3742 was taking off from dca runway 1 bound for pensacola international airport (pns).
the ntsb preliminary report found that inadequate line-of-sight radio coverage caused the failure, and the faa resolved the issue by relocating radio equipment to the top of the dca control tower.
the ntsb stated the aircraft remained within required separation limits because their 700-foot vertical separation exceeded the 500-foot minimum.
